ideas.pitch: A localized peer-to-peer microgrid monitoring and energy-sharing simulator designed specifically for collegiate campuses like Govt. Model Engineering College.
ideas.title: CampusGrid-MEC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the overarching theme of high-impact real-world engineering challenges by solving a tangible campus infrastructure problem, appealing directly to local alumni and institutional mentors judging the event.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise-grade schema migration validator and query optimizer tailored for high-throughput SaaS applications, built with KeyValue sponsor integration in mind.
ideas.title: KeyValue-QueryMesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with KeyValue's engineering-centric background by focusing on backend developer tooling rather than a consumer app, matching the pattern of genuinely hard engineering seen in successful hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-driven water quality monitoring and anomaly forecasting dashboard built for institutional water tanks and supply lines.
ideas.title: AquaSense-MEC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a live, working hardware/IoT simulation with predictive analytics, ensuring a bulletproof live demo that judges can interact with directly.

ideas.pitch: A real-time public transit load balancer and arrival time estimator using crowd-sourced GPS traces and transit static data for Kochi.
ideas.title: TransitFlow-Kochi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediately recognizable local problem in Kochi, guaranteeing high engagement and resonance with local judges and student peers.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision safety compliance monitor for collegiate hardware and chemistry labs using edge-optimized object detection.
ideas.title: LabGuard-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles campus safety and resource management with a working computer vision pipeline that can be demonstrated live using webcam feeds.
